name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

proofOfReserves.provider: MKS PAMP (bar serial numbers + independent physical audits)

mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA (Swiss VQF/FINMA SRO); each token is minted against an allocated troy ounce of PAMP gold in Swiss vaults and burned on physical redemption, through the issuer's controlled backend.

controls.label: Gold Token SA issuance backend
controls.evidence: Gold Token SA mints DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce) and burns on 1:1 physical redemption; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless mint route.
